full_grid_not_recorded_explanation: 432 stage records in frozen full-grid analysis belong to 72 never-admitted trials; they are not failed attempts.

comparability.base_prompt_difference: Only the final workflow paragraph differs: current P0 retains the initial majority separately and makes the final handoff Stage B-only; prior prompt handed off initial votes. Classification/evidence-boundary paragraphs remain byte-identical.
comparability.scope: Canonical topic fields compared, not full catalogue bytes. Current StageA addendum/schema/native wrappers and StageB source review differ from earlier descriptor-only protocol; no isolated causal comparison.

historical_descriptor_pilot.usage_comparison: Earlier pilot usage has not been measured here; no cost ratio is estimated.

limitations: Only P0 was run: no prompt comparison is estimable.
Model/effort differences are descriptive; ordering, time, load, service interruptions and account switch are confounded.
Stage B combines source access, reconsideration and anchoring; changes do not establish corrected errors.
First attempts are primary. Recovery variants are supplementary and do not erase first-attempt missingness.
Confidence is ordinal self-report, never vote weight or calibrated probability.
One recorded coordinator-guide exposure deviation remains flagged; literal outputs are retained.
Prior QA covers ten synthetic technical fixtures, not human-reference accuracy or construct validity.
scope: 12 admitted P0 trials, 36 original readers; 72 further trials remain unstarted on human hold.
